name: codewiki
description: Gives Codex a maintained wiki and structural index of the repository through the CodeWiki backend.

interface.longDescription: Gives Codex the repository's CodeWiki: a wiki that writes itself and stays current, and a structural index of the code. 27 MCP tools read it and write its explanations, a briefing at the start of each session says whether it is up to date, and two skills cover when to call which tool and how to edit a note by hand.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of this repository's architecture.
What should I know before I change this file?
Bring the wiki up to date with the code.
